subject: Re: Last-sprint request — credit support to finish pilot
messages:
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@openpilot.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-26T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — small credit to finish pilot this week

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the time last week — the team is seeing promising latency gains but we hit a quota wall on day 9 of the pilot. Can we get a short one-week extension and a small token credit to finish the last round of edge tests? If we can complete the last integration tests by Friday we can present to execs the following Tuesday.

What we're asking: 7-day extension + 300k token credit (to cover a heavy batch of inference for new telemetry tests).

If you need a quick plan, I can share the usage breakdown and the tests we'll run. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Sam Torres
Head of Integrations, OpenPilot AI
sam.torres@openpilot.ai
+1 415-555-0128

Attachment: openpilot-pilot-usage-report.csv (summary of daily token use, 9/1–9/25)

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-26T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — small credit to finish pilot this week

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Sam's ask. Pilot looks solid; they just need a short runway. My read: approving an onetime 300k token credit + 7-day extension should be low lift and high chance to convert.

Key points: 
- They hit quota because tests ramped unexpectedly (see attachment).
- They shared an exec review target (next Tue) — timing aligns with EoQ push.
- We should pin redemption rules (not applied to unrelated activity) and get DocuSign for the approval.

Can we authorize up to $5k equivalent credit (approx. 300k tokens on their plan) and Marissa loop finance/legal for the quick sign-off?

—Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — small credit to finish pilot this week

Olga / Marissa — good catch. I approve a one-time 300k token credit and the 7-day extension. Conditions:

- Credit valid only for project OP-2027-042 (OpenPilot AI pilot).
- Extension expires 2027-10-06 23:59 PT if not accepted by Sam.
- Require signed approval sheet (I'll sign) and counter-signed DocuSign from the customer.

Marissa — can you generate the authorization PDF and run the quick finance check? I'll route the credit in our billing console once we have the signed form. If legal needs to review a line or two, loop them but keep it minimal.

Ben Carter
Sr. Account Exec — West
Redwood Inference

Sam
